objective: maximize candidate-region hit, full lesion inclusion, and target coverage before native-resolution local segmentation

stage1.architecture: lightweight prompt-conditioned 3D U-Net with text FiLM
stage1.input: entire crop-to-nonzero CT, z-scored once in native space, resampled through 2 mm to 4 mm isotropic, center-padded to 192^3
stage1.target: global grid positions whose mapped native 192^3 patch fully contains the finding; hit-region fallback only when full inclusion is geometrically impossible
stage1.loss: foreground-weighted BCE + Tversky(beta=0.8) + valid-center probability-mass ranking loss; downweighted empty-prompt BCE

strict_inclusion.description: supervise only candidate centers satisfying full inclusion

inclusion_margin16mm.description: expand inclusion-center supervision by 16 mm to favor recall and robustness

stage2.normalization: native crop-to-nonzero full-volume z-score once before crop extraction

resource_coordination.cascade_launch_rule: defer while assigned GPU memory exceeds 15 GiB or exp004 has an incomplete checkpoint evaluation
